text:
Jae: Quick sync request 1: need a lightweight regional handoff play for SI co-sell + HW partners for Marketplace launches. Thinking short claim TTL, region windows, and a central "claim-queue". Thoughts? @Priya @Marco-SI
Priya: agree we need something narrow. Suggest claim TTL = 3 business days (short), then drops to open pool unless escalated. Regions should run independent windows to reduce thrash.
Marco-SI: from SI POV we need an explicit tech-ownership flag (did we deliver POC or code?). If true, claim TTL extends to 7 days. Also want automatic credit tagging in CRM.
Elena: marketing/legal input: marketplace listing freeze = 7 calendar days before publish. Legal needs logo signoff min 3 business days. We should bake those deadlines into the manifest.
Jae: ok combine: claim TTL default 3bd, extends to 7bd when tech_ownership=true. Marketplace freeze 7d. We'll run region windows: Americas 09:30-11:30 PT, EMEA 15:00-17:00 CET, APAC 11:00-13:00 SGT.
Marco-SI: +1. Also need a small evidence spec: acceptable = repo PR link, demo recording with attendee list, signed SOW, or partner engineering ticket. Low-confidence = calendar invite + notes.
Priya: I'll draft a "claim manifest" CSV template. Proposed headers (simple):
```
global_account_id, canonical_name, region_scope, sales_owner, si_org, hw_vendor, claim_ts_utc, claim_ttl_days, claim_reason, proof_url, tech_ownership, crm_sync_id, publish_ready_flag
```
Elena: add `marketing_asset_status` and `legal_logo_clearance` columns. Also `marketplace_sku_lock` to indicate freeze.
Jae: good call. ops-bot can run nightly dedupe and surface collisions with a confidence score. We should post collisions to #partnerships-ops for adjudication on Fridays.
ops-bot: scheduled job created: "si-handoff-dedupe" running nightly 02:00 UTC. Report link: https://redwood.internal/ops/reports/si-handoff/2801234567 :robot_face:
Marco-SI: adjudication flow suggestion: 1) attempt auto-resolve by confidence >80, 2) if both claims have tech_ownership=true escalate to triage group, 3) otherwise first-claim wins. Keep manual escalations <48h.
Priya: agreed. We'll add a `confidence_pct` and `auto_resolve_reason` column so triage has context. Also `rebuttal_channel` field for quick back-and-forth.
Elena: marketing timeline: if claim has marketplace_sku_lock=true, ops must sign off before freeze cutoff or asset excluded. That keeps the publish queue clean.
Jae: operational roles for pilot: Priya = manifest owner, Marco-SI = SI evidence liaison, Elena = marketing approvals, Jae = final arb. Pilot window = two weeks around the launch.
Marco-SI: one edge case: global accounts with multiple region teams. Proposal: canonical_global_owner field to prevent double regional claims.
Priya: will include `canonical_global_owner` in CSV and a `region_owner` per-row. Also adding `claim_channel` (slack thread URL) for traceability.
LegalBot: reminder: partner logo usage policy v2 requires partner signed asset use addendum. Attach link: https://redwood.internal/legal/logo-policy-v2. Please route approvals via legal@redwood.
Jae: ok action items: Priya drop CSV template + example rows, Marco-SI share evidence checklist, Elena draft marketplace freeze checklist, ops-bot post first dedupe report tomorrow. We'll run a 2-week pilot for the AcmeHardware integration. Reconvene Friday 10:30 PT for adjudication walkthrough.
Priya: will post template in this thread by EOD.
Marco-SI: sending example repo/ticket links in 30m.
Elena: draft checklist in flight.
Jae: thanks everyone 39; trying to keep handoffs crisp so launches don't stall. If you see conflicting claims outside windows just flag with `#hand-off` and ops-bot will pick them up. :pray:
